John Danaher - Ageless Jiu Jitsu - Compl.overview: John Danaher's gi bottom game for older or less athletic grapplers, eight volumes. Volume 1 covers getting to the ground efficiently from standing (including pulling into ashi garami). Volume 2 covers pin escapes adapted for older players (a different pattern of escape). Volume 3 covers using your longest limbs, the legs, as an equaliser (the classic tripod sweep and others). Volumes 4 to 6 cover half guard, which Danaher argues is the best guard for less athletic players: getting back to it, the tight waist series and roll-through sweep, and the overhook half guard game. Volume 7 covers closed guard and getting there from half guard. Volume 8 covers the scissor sweep variations.

John Danaher - Ageless Jiu Jitsu - Compl.overview: John Danaher's gi top game for older or less athletic grapplers, eight volumes. It covers safe, energy-efficient guard passing (passing approaches that don't rely on speed, leading to half guard and pins), heavy pinning that tires the opponent rather than you, and high-percentage finishes from top (collar chokes and arm locks). The publisher listing has no per-volume breakdown for the gi top game; the no-gi version follows the same structure (half guard top, chest-to-chest, upper and lower body battles, pinning, americana, kimura and kata gatame).
